::: {#def-acceptance-ratio}
#### Acceptance ratio

For a target posterior $\p(\vparam \mid \vy) \propto \p(\vy \mid \vparam)\, \p(\vparam)$,
a [proposal distribution](#def-proposal-distribution) $q$,
a current value $\vparam^{(t)}$, and a candidate $\vparam^*$,
the **acceptance ratio** is

$$
\accept \eqdef
\frac{\p(\vy \mid \vparam^*)\, \p(\vparam^*)}{\p(\vy \mid \vparam^{(t)})\, \p(\vparam^{(t)})}
\cdot
\frac{q(\vparam^{(t)} \mid \vparam^*)}{q(\vparam^* \mid \vparam^{(t)})}.
$$

:::
